Brand Identity Process Sketch-to-vector logo development, built from the ground up.
FAI Logo: The Sketch Where it begins: a pencil idea on lined paper, before a single vector line is drawn.
FAI Logo: Taking Shape Grid guides and anchor points turn the rough sketch into clean, precise vector shapes.
FAI Logo: Sketch vs Vector The finished mark beside its original sketch. Shared online, it drew 114 reactions and 28 comments.
Eminent Media Logo: Step 1 The sketch is traced and the first letterform takes shape.
Eminent Media Logo: Step 2 A second shape joins in and the rising peak begins to appear.
Eminent Media Logo: Step 3 The full mark comes together, still guided by the original sketch.
Eminent Media: Final Mark (Dark) The finished identity in white on black: bold, clean and ready for any dark background.
Eminent Media: Final Mark (Colour) The same mark in orange and deep blue on white, ready for everyday brand use.
